description: This file defines the Quotes class for the vtiger CRM system, including methods for retrieving related sales orders, activities, history, and stage history, as well as report query generation and relationship management.

classes.name: Quotes
classes.description: Represents the Quotes entity in vtiger CRM, handling data retrieval, relationship management, and report query generation.

methods.name: Quotes
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the module data, including inventory product details and currency info.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Retrieves sales orders related to a specific quote.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to a specific quote.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves activity history for a specific quote.

methods.name: get_quotestagehistory
methods.description: Retrieves the stage change history for a specific quote.

methods.name: get_column_value
methods.description: Overrides base method to handle potentialid and contactid fields.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates the secondary query part for report related to quotes.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks a quote from another entity based on module and ID.
